name: superset-helm-chart-0.15.5
body: Apache Superset is a modern, enterprise-ready business intelligence web application

Hello Community,

The Apache Superset team is pleased to announce that Superset
6.1.0 has just been released.

Apache Superset is a modern, enterprise-ready business intelligence web application.

The official source release:
https://downloads.apache.org/superset/6.1.0

The PyPI package:
https://pypi.org/project/apache_superset/6.1.0

The CHANGELOG for the release:
https://github.com/apache/superset/blob/6.1.0/CHANGELOG/6.1.0.md

The instructions for updating to the release:
https://github.com/apache/superset/blob/6.1.0/UPDATING.md

If you have any usage questions or have problems when upgrading or
find any issues with enhancements included in this release, please
don't hesitate to let us know by sending feedback.

name: 6.1.0rc3
body:
Subject: [VOTE] Release Apache Superset 6.1.0 based on Superset 6.1.0rc3

Hello Superset Community,

This is a call for the vote to release Apache Superset version 6.1.0.

The release candidate:
https://dist.apache.org/repos/dist/dev/superset/6.1.0rc3/

The Git tag for the release:
https://github.com/apache/superset/tree/6.1.0rc3

The CHANGELOG for the release:
https://github.com/apache/superset/blob/6.1.0rc3/CHANGELOG/6.1.0.md

The instructions for updating to the release:
https://github.com/apache/superset/blob/6.1.0rc3/UPDATING.md

Public keys are available at:
https://www.apache.org/dist/superset/KEYS

This vote also includes the following new NPM and PyPI packages:
https://www.npmjs.com/package/@apache-superset/core/v/0.1.0-rc3
https://pypi.org/project/apache-superset-core/0.1.0rc3/
https://pypi.org/project/apache-superset-extensions-cli/0.1.0rc3/

The vote will be left open until at least 72 hours have passed
and the necessary number of votes (3) have been reached.

Please vote accordingly:

[ ] +1 approve
[ ] +0 no opinion
[ ] -1 disapprove with the reason

Thanks,
The Apache Superset Team
